title: Export never overwrites warp markers edited in the DAW
description:
## Behavior
Export never destroys corrections made in the DAW that have not been imported yet.

```gherkin
Feature: Export keeps the DAW's corrections

  Scenario: A sidecar edited in the DAW is not overwritten
    Given "steady-120.wav.asd" beside the audio holds markers that differ from Apricity's grid
    When I export its sidecar
    Then the sidecar is unchanged
    And the output says "steady-120.wav.asd has warp markers edited in the DAW; import them with apricity import --markers steady-120.wav.asd, or pass --force to replace them"
    And the command fails

  Scenario: An identical sidecar is left alone
    Given "steady-120.wav.asd" already holds exactly Apricity's grid
    When I export its sidecar
    Then the output says "steady-120.wav.asd unchanged"

  Scenario: --force replaces an edited sidecar
    Given "steady-120.wav.asd" holds markers edited in the DAW
    When I export its sidecar with --force
    Then the sidecar holds Apricity's grid

  Scenario: --dry-run writes nothing
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars steady-120.wav --dry-run"
    Then no file is written
    And the output lists "would write steady-120.wav.asd (18 warp markers, complex)"
```
